objective.text: Supply a PHP default value for an optional route argument.

difficulty.rationale: Satisfy an absent URI value at the PHP invocation boundary.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

stem: For Route::get("/greet/{name?}", ...), the handler should return "Hello guest" for /greet and "Hello Ada" for /greet/Ada. Which handler supports both without an argument error?

options.rationale: The route placeholder is optional, but the PHP argument remains required.
options.misconception: The route placeholder is optional, but the PHP argument remains required.

options.rationale: This avoids an argument error but returns Hello with an empty name instead of the required guest fallback.
options.misconception: This avoids an argument error but returns Hello with an empty name instead of the required guest fallback.

options.rationale: The PHP default supplies the omitted optional route parameter while a present value replaces it.
Nullable allows null when supplied; it does not make the PHP parameter optional without a default.
options.misconception: Nullable allows null when supplied; it does not make the PHP parameter optional without a default.
